name: Assistant
empty: Ask for a change to the deck — the assistant answers here.

agent.building: Building the deck on the “{template}” template. Slides appear on the left as they are laid out.
agent.stopped: Stopped. What is laid out stays — you can run it again from the card above.
agent.opened: Kept the “{variant}” variant. The other two are in the project. What should I change?
agent.openedNoProject: Kept the “{variant}” variant. The other two are next to it in your presentations. What should I change?
agent.unsupported: For now I only build decks: edits on request arrive with the editor agent.
agent.templateImportFailed: Could not read the “{template}” template. Check that the file opens in PowerPoint and start again — or pick one of the templates you have already uploaded.
agent.templateSaved: The template is saved to the library — it will appear in your templates.
agent.templateAttachFailed: Could not attach the template to the “{project}” project. I will still build the deck with it; you can attach it later on the project’s Templates tab.
agent.contextSeen: I can see: {items}. I can’t edit slides on request yet — that arrives with the editor agent.

import.failedUnknown: Reading stopped without a reason. Please try again.

template.demoProfile: Demo mode does not read the file: this is a demo profile, not the profile of this template.

work.failedUnknown: The run stopped without a reason. Please try again.

audience.title: Who is this presentation for?

attachTemplate.title: Attach the template to the “{project}” project?

attach.label: Attach to “{project}”

deckOnly.label: Only for this presentation
deckOnly.description: The template stays in the library; the project does not change

dense.name: Dense
dense.description: More text and data per slide

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Text and white space in equal measure
